summary.en: A rotating object stores kinetic energy in its spin, given by one half its moment of inertia times its angular velocity squared — the rotational counterpart of one half mv².
summary.et: Pöörlev objekt talletab kineetilist energiat oma pöörlemises, mille annab pool inertsimomendi ja nurkkiiruse ruudu korrutisest — see on pöörlemisanaloog avaldisele pool mv².
